title: Where the aerial was taken
what_we_know: The family kept a strike photograph as somewhere in Germany. Strip fields, villages, woods, a rail line, bursts on a town with a rail yard. The print names no place and no date, and no mission has been matched to it.
what_we_dont: Which town is under the smoke, and on which of Frank's missions, if any, the picture was made.
what_might_answer_it: The back of the print; the 95th's strike photographs for the crew's missions; a match of the rail line and villages against 1945 maps or present-day imagery.
evidence_needed: A strike photograph or mission record naming the target, or a terrain match a second reader confirms.
